name: Nick Kleeman
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Nick practices using ACT, solution focused therapy, mindfulness approaches and CBT, and uses a trauma-informed approach across all his therapeutic work. Nick provides a safe and inclusive therapy space for people of all backgrounds and has experience working with people from LGBTIQ+ and CALD communities. Modalities include Parts Work Therapy.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, ADHD, Addiction, Parts Work, Trauma-informed, Anxiety, Depression

name: Niloo Danaei
title: Clinical Psychologist & qualified Social Worker
description: I am particularly passionate about supporting individuals affected by traumatic experiences, using a trauma-informed lens to guide their healing journey. I'm a trauma-informed Psychologist and a Level 1 IFS trained therapist. Clinical interests include psychological trauma (intergenerational, complex trauma), gender and sexuality, sexual problems; LGBTQAI+ ally and neurodivergence affirming. Languages: Farsi, Dari.
specialties: Complex trauma, Intergenerational trauma, Gender and sexuality, Sexual problems, LGBTQIA+ ally, IFS, Farsi, Dari

name: Pete Steele
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Working days: Tuesdays & Wednesdays 8am to 2pm (Prahran). Pete has experience treating anxiety, depression, trauma-related difficulties, body-image concerns, OCD and more. Pete strives to provide a safe and inclusive therapeutic space for people of all backgrounds and has significant experience working with people from LGBTIQ+ and CALD communities, and uses a trauma-informed approach across all his therapeutic work.
specialties: PTSD, Trauma, Childhood abuse, LGBTIQ+, OCD, CBT, ACT

name: Poorna Selvaraja
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Poorna has developed expertise in working with people experiencing anxiety, depression, mood and personality disorders, relationship difficulties, trauma, complex trauma (gender-based violence, migrant, asylum seeker and refugee contexts), life stressors and cultural adjustment. She is trained in several therapeutic approaches including CBT, Schema Therapy and Psychodynamic Therapy.
specialties: Complex trauma, Refugee and migrant trauma, Schema Therapy, Personality disorders

name: Rebekah Barson
title: Individual and Couples Counsellor (Mental Health Social Worker)
description: Rebekah is a clinical Mental Health Social Worker with additional training in Psychotherapy, Relationship Counselling and ACT, who works with both individuals and couples. Clinical interests include past trauma and difficult early life events, relationship issues and perinatal mental health.
specialties: Past trauma, Couples, Perinatal, ACT, EFT

name: Ricki Knoetze
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Ricki draws from evidence-based therapies including CBT, ACT and psychodynamic approaches. She has worked with adolescents and adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, OCD, ADHD, grief and interpersonal issues. Clinical interests include PTSD and trauma; modalities include Internal Family Systems.

name: Ruby Bouhadana
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I work with adults navigating anxiety, depression, complex trauma, emotional overwhelm and dysregulation, relationship difficulties, self-esteem difficulties, and study/work burnout. My work is informed by Internal Family Systems, CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy, and mindfulness-based practices. I welcome all parts of a person's experience without judgment.
specialties: Complex trauma, Schema Therapy, IFS, Emotion regulation, Anxiety
